channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The supply chain kept printing records while the market argued about returns. TSMC reported Q3 revenue of US$46.72 billion, above its US$44.6 to 45.8 billion guide, with a 66.4% gross margin, 3 nm at 33% and 2 nm at 8% of wafer revenue, guided Q4 to US$52.3 to 54.3 billion and reiterated 2026 capex of US$60 to 64 billion. On the grid, PJM filed a FERC study agreement (ER27-126) to evaluate SB Energy's Flagship campus in Pike County, Ohio as one package: 10,370 MW of firm load, about 10,170 MW of new GE Vernova gas generation and three 765 kV lines, with OpenAI named as the tenant and the developer paying for the study. In Korea, NeoAI Cloud closed KRW 600 billion of financing for a 40 MW Pohang AI data center, with NHN Cloud pre-leasing 16 MW, and in India CapitaLand launched a 34 MW IT data center in Chennai. Against that, Gartner said over US$3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure spending could face impairment by 2030 and that over 80% of neoclouds will cease independent operations, and Korea's KOSPI fell 7.57% on 15 October with SK Hynix down 11%. On the public silicon tape every venue returned HTTP 200 and every print held: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW.

item.title: Compute brief - 15 October 2026
item.description: The supply chain kept printing records while the market argued about returns. TSMC reported Q3 revenue of US$46.72 billion, above its US$44.6 to 45.8 billion guide, with a 66.4% gross margin, 3 nm at 33% and 2 nm at 8% of wafer revenue, guided Q4 to US$52.3 to 54.3 billion and reiterated 2026 capex of US$60 to 64 billion. On the grid, PJM filed a FERC study agreement (ER27-126) to evaluate SB Energy's Flagship campus in Pike County, Ohio as one package: 10,370 MW of firm load, about 10,170 MW of new GE Vernova gas generation and three 765 kV lines, with OpenAI named as the tenant and the developer paying for the study. In Korea, NeoAI Cloud closed KRW 600 billion of financing for a 40 MW Pohang AI data center, with NHN Cloud pre-leasing 16 MW, and in India CapitaLand launched a 34 MW IT data center in Chennai. Against that, Gartner said over US$3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure spending could face impairment by 2030 and that over 80% of neoclouds will cease independent operations, and Korea's KOSPI fell 7.57% on 15 October with SK Hynix down 11%. On the public silicon tape every venue returned HTTP 200 and every print held: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Countries: United States / Ohio: PJM files executed study agreement at FERC (ER27-126) for SB Energy's Flagship campus at the former Portsmouth plant: 800 MW initial plus about 9,570 MW, 10,370 MW firm NITS, about 10,170 MW gas, three 765 kV lines, phased through 2032; OpenAI named as tenant. Study only, no approvals (Wire, 13 Oct). South Korea: NeoAI Cloud closes KRW 600 billion (KRW 450 billion PF closed 7 Oct plus KRW 150 billion equity, SC Capital Partners) for a 40 MW / 32 MW IT Pohang AI data center; NHN Cloud pre-leases 16 MW; service Q4 2027 (Wire, 12 Oct). KOSPI fell 7.57% on 15 Oct (Signal). India: CapitaLand India Trust launches Chennai 01 in Ambattur: 34 MW IT, 53 MW gross, about US$203 million, completion by end 2026; no tenant named (Wire, 15 Oct). Taiwan: TSMC Q3 2026 revenue US$46.72 billion (guide US$44.6 to 45.8 billion), gross margin 66.4%; Q4 guide US$52.3 to 54.3 billion; 2026 capex US$60 to 64 billion reiterated, 2026 to 2028 capex significantly higher than the prior three years (Signal).
